rows.owner_admin_action: Confirm the first paid-lead preflight shows 3 routable Bituach Leumi specialists.
rows.required_proof: Published/private lawyer profiles are routable, have Bituach Leumi area, routing enabled, accepted commercial terms, billing contact and remaining lead capacity.
rows.pass_condition: Preflight has no supply, billing or routing-capacity blockers.
rows.fail_stop: Fewer than 3 routable specialists blocks the controlled lead drill.
rows.crm_anchor: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Bituach Leumi specialist supply -> First paid-lead routing preflight
rows.forbidden_action: Do not route leads to non-routable or unpaid/unverified profiles.
rows.repo_privacy_rule: Do not put live lawyer IDs, emails or private billing fields in repo artifacts.

rows.owner_admin_action: Select one current Bituach Leumi lead with explicit match permission.
rows.required_proof: Lead has explicit_match_consent or owner_verified_consent, owner release note, Bituach Leumi appeal intent and no do-not-contact signal.
rows.pass_condition: Consent evidence and owner release are recorded before routing_hold is cleared.
rows.fail_stop: No explicit permission, unclear permission, old legacy row, or do-not-contact blocks the drill.
rows.crm_anchor: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Held Bituach Leumi lead triage / permission queue
rows.allowed_next_action: Prepare no-PII partner preview or controlled route.
rows.forbidden_action: Do not infer consent from a WhatsApp click, old chat, silence, emoji or missed call.
rows.repo_privacy_rule: No client name, phone, email, documents, raw chat or exact address in repo artifacts.

rows.owner_admin_action: Prepare a no-PII preview of the controlled Bituach Leumi lead.
rows.required_proof: Preview includes general issue, urgency and region only if safe; excludes name, phone, email, exact address, documents and raw WhatsApp/TalkTo content.
rows.pass_condition: Partner terms and billing contact are already accepted before any PII release.
rows.fail_stop: Partner has not accepted terms or billing contact, or preview contains PII.
rows.crm_anchor: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Partner preview / terms queue
rows.allowed_next_action: Manual handoff only after owner release confirms consent and terms.
rows.forbidden_action: Do not send screenshots, raw chats, medical documents or full contact details at preview stage.
rows.repo_privacy_rule: Repo can record preview-ready yes/no only.

rows.owner_admin_action: Perform one controlled manual/routed handoff after all prior proof rows pass.
rows.required_proof: Owner release confirms client permission, accepted partner terms, billing contact, manual-only scope and lead price/fee.
rows.pass_condition: The lead reaches one accepted specialist and creates a qualified billing queue item.
rows.fail_stop: Any missing owner release, partner terms or consent keeps routing_hold on.
rows.crm_anchor: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Owner handoff release queue
rows.allowed_next_action: Move to billing queue and request invoice/payment proof.
rows.forbidden_action: Do not automate webhooks, bulk route, or contact additional partners from this drill.
rows.repo_privacy_rule: No live handoff details in repo; keep exact IDs in wp-admin.

rows.owner_admin_action: Record manual invoice/payment request for the accepted partner.
rows.required_proof: Qualified lead billing status, invoice reference or payment request reference, suggested price and billable partner are recorded.
rows.pass_condition: Invoice_sent can be recorded only with reference; paid can be recorded only with proof.
rows.fail_stop: No invoice/reference means no invoice_sent; no payment evidence means no paid revenue claim.
rows.crm_anchor: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Qualified lead billing queue
rows.allowed_next_action: Wait for payment evidence and record it privately.
rows.forbidden_action: Do not mark paid or claim first paid lead from a promise to pay.
rows.repo_privacy_rule: Repo may say reference present yes/no; no private invoice or payment URLs.

rows.owner_admin_action: Verify actual payment proof exists before counting revenue.
rows.required_proof: qualified_lead_billing_status=paid and private payment evidence URL is present; invoice reference alone is not paid proof.
rows.pass_condition: Paid status has proof, no refund/dispute/complaint is open, and owner confirms one-time revenue count.
rows.fail_stop: Any missing proof, dispute, refund, complaint or ethics concern blocks revenue count.
rows.crm_anchor: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Qualified lead billing queue
rows.allowed_next_action: Record first paid-lead achievement and prepare scale/no-go review.
rows.forbidden_action: Do not count paid revenue from screenshots outside CRM or undocumented owner notes.
rows.repo_privacy_rule: Payment evidence stays private; repo only records proof-present status.

rows.owner_admin_action: Decide whether to repeat, repair or stop the Bituach Leumi paid-lead loop.
rows.required_proof: All prior drill rows pass; owner confirms supply quality, consent process, billing proof, refund path and no unresolved complaints.
rows.pass_condition: Owner approves controlled repeat batches, or holds for repair.
rows.fail_stop: Any unresolved blocker keeps the loop in controlled/manual mode only.
rows.crm_anchor: Owner review after live CRM proof exists
rows.allowed_next_action: Repeat small controlled batches after approval.
rows.forbidden_action: Do not publish public claims, scale WhatsApp/TalkTo imports or automate lead routing from one incomplete drill.
rows.repo_privacy_rule: Scale decision can be summarized without live client/lawyer/payment details.
